opener_concept: Eight people queuing at a bus stop, drawn as an inline SVG, split into four equal groups. The student answers by pure common sense: 2 people per group, 4 people in front of the middle cut, 4 people between the outer two cuts. The reveal then names the three cuts as Q1, the median and Q3, and names the stretch between the outer cuts as the interquartile range.
